response.original_title: [Quick Guide] How Do I Upgrade a room on a Silversea cruise?
response.overview: Upgrading a suite on a Silversea cruise generally involves three primary options +1-888-512- 8367: Silversea Upgrade Program (Bidding): For eligible sailings +1-888-512-8367, you can submit a blind cash offer for a higher-tier suite via email invitation or the Silversea Upgrade Page +1-888-512-8367. Bids are not guaranteed; if accepted, the payment is non-refundable, and if declined, you retain your original accommodation at no extra charge +1-888-512-8367. Paying the Fare Difference: You or your travel advisor can contact Silversea prior to final payment to pay the cash difference for an outright category change +1-888-512-8367.
